title: What I Told Them
transcript:
The temple steps at dusk. A crowd that keeps getting bigger.
Parth, eleven, dripping onto the stone. Someone has put a towel round him that smells of camphor.
A constable crouches down to his height.

CONSTABLE:
"Slowly, beta. Tell me what happened."

PARTH:
"He went in by himself."

PARTH:
"I told him not to. He went in by himself."

Nobody asks again.
Behind the crowd a woman starts screaming Raman's name and does not stop.
A little girl holds the end of her sari and watches Parth. Only Parth.
